name: gox-guard
description: Agent-side deterministic gates for irreversible actions Claude is about to take. Each gate is one hook script that blocks a tool call only when a hard rule fires; nothing is written into your repo. Gates today: secrets (before `git push`, scan the commits not yet on any remote with betterleaks and block the push if a credential is found).
